title: Next-ball count coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $\sigma.c$ at coordinate $11$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the value of the register vector
associated with $\sigma$ at coordinate $11$ is the next-ball count $c$ of $\sigma$.
